title: BEACON D5 mutual-aid request board (FR-D4-2, FEV-21)
description: The wire shape of the mutual-aid board (src/application/coordination/mutual-aid-board.ts): a VIEW over RESOURCE_TASK rows correlated by the EDXL-RM OriginatingMessageID (`edxlRmRef`). BEACON has no ResourceRequest entity, so this document deliberately carries no requester, quantity or fulfilment percentage. A correlation chain spanning more than one incident is NOT collapsed into one row — it appears under `conflicts` with its reason (flag, never merge). Aggregate-only (Art. XIV): every identifier here names a TASK, RESOURCE, INCIDENT or SHELTER — never a person.

requests.description: Correlated mutual-aid chains, ascending by edxlRmRef.

local.description: Taskings carrying no correlation id — surfaced as local, never dropped and never invented into a chain.

conflicts.description: Chains that could not be rendered as one request row, with the reason.

taskStatus.description: RESOURCE_TASK_STATUSES verbatim (src/domain/resource-task.ts:9). Pinned to the domain union by test.

status.description: Furthest-advanced lifecycle state in the chain, by the domain's forward-only order.

shelterId.description: Present only when every tasking in the chain names the SAME shelter.

statusCounts.description: TASK counts per lifecycle state over every supplied tasking; every key present, zeros included.
